'''Incinerator stormtroopers''', often referred to as '''Incinerator Troopers''', were a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] variant that specialized in the use of [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. They were often used to burn out entrenched enemy positions, or commit acts of genocide under their [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. They had red markings, similar to that of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Guard]].

==Overview==
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from human stock, these  [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were raised to be pyromaniacs, taught from a young age to burn away insurrection against the New Order. Typically, these troopers would use powerful [[Plasma rifle/Legends|plasma rifles]], or the [[oppressor flamethrower]]s. These main weapons were strong enough to burn down entire villages, and even cities. In addition, these troopers also used [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r blaster pistols]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They could also utilize [[Ash Ruination of New Plympto|thermobaric canisters]] and [[Mortar/Legends|mortar launchers]] to supplement their main armament.

Their armor was exceptionally heat-resistant, able to withstand the high temperatures. The armor bore similar markings to [[Imperial shock trooper]]s, to intimidate the enemy and indicate their specialized nature.

Incinerator stormtroopers were sent on missions where an example needed to be made. They would march into settlements and burn them to the ground, leaving nothing standing. They did not hesitate to ignite civilian bystanders as well.<ref name="TFUCC">{{WebCite|url=http://www.potf2.com/potj/forums/topic.asp?TOPIC_ID=11810&whichpage=7|text=Packaging of the The Force Unleashed Commemorative Collection|archivedate=20160304015339|nolive=1}}</ref>

==History==
As dissent grew amongst the Empire's member systems, the Empire needed a way to make an example of systems. The Empire cloned incinerator stormtroopers from a Human's genetic stock, with the intention to turn them into [[Psychopathy|psychopathic]] pyromaniacs. As they were raised they were trained to develop an incredible desire to burn and destroy. Sent on missions to burn down villages and incite panic, they were usually accompanied by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], although they were known to operate without him.<ref name="TFUCC" />

They were sent to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] to quell any potential [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|uprisings]] during the construction of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slave [[Skyhook/Legends|Skyhook]]. A number of them were also present during the Imperial [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|occupation]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="TFUCC" />

Incinerator stormtroopers were also largely responsible for the [[Ash Ruination of New Plympto]], which they won solely with thermobaric canisters. According to Han Solo, they also were responsible for the destruction of [[Kepitenochan/Legends|Kepitenochan]].<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Two figures of incinerator troopers are packaged with Darth Vader in a ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' action figure pack.

In ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'', the incinerator trooper can be unlocked as a secret costume using the code "PHOENIX".
